assumption_ledger.note: Privacy review team can complete sign-off within operational window.
Security review team can complete sign-off within operational window.
No confirmation that vendor sandbox environment is configured to receive redacted replay package.
Audit ticket must be created and linked before exception activation per audit_log_rules.md.

mitigations: Require both privacy and security review sign-off before activation
Tie exception to audit ticket before granting access
Enforce 24-hour expiry with least-privilege sandbox-only scoping
Use redacted replay package instead of raw production traces
primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor access to C3 customer replay data carries privacy and security exposure if approvals or audit controls are bypassed.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval matches access-policy v2.1 narrow exception path.
Sanitized sample bundle is policy-safe but less useful than P2 when replay exceptions are allowed.
Outright denial is over-correction when a narrower policy-compliant path exists via P2.
Local admin tool can mint tokens but bypasses required approvals and audit. Technically possible but policy-forbidden.
